verdict.rationale: CrewAI's core agent/task/crew/flow definitions are fundamentally code-first (Python API), so most of what the enterprise no-code Visual Agent/Task Builder and Crew Studio do can equivalently be done via code/CLI, and deployed crews expose REST endpoints (kickoff, status, resume) plus webhooks for programmatic control. However, the enterprise UI-only features—Crew Studio no-code crew creation, Tool Repository publish/install, and dashboard-based monitoring—have no documented API equivalents for building/publishing outside the UI, so full UI/API parity is not evidenced. Missing for 10: API endpoints for creating/configuring agents-tasks equivalent to Crew Studio, an API for publishing/installing tools from the Tool Repository, and confirmation that all monitoring/observability UI views are also accessible via API.
